# My Penguins Quarto (Git Demo)

## Load Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)
```

## Summary Table of Average Bill Length by Species

```{r}
data_summary <- penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(
    avg_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

data_summary
```
